data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu had 41 GitHub contributions across five repositories, led by 31 commits in UTMIST/Misty. He also made commits in qiuethan/now, qiuethan/Portfolio, UTMIST/UTMIST, and qiuethan/qiuethan, and opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#246, #254, #255, #256) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#481, #484). He reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, and opened issue UTMIST/UTMIST#483.
